newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers moving higher with cargo quotes.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers moving higher with cargo quotes.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were quoted higher on Monday in line with bullish cargo quotes, traders said.
They also said most sellers were holding back on offers, anticipating levels to rise on further gains on cargo quotes later today.

Majors were offering 380-cst at $100 per tonne and 180-cst at $105 per tonne while independents were asking at about $2-$3 per tonne lower. "The market will probably move higher later with a handful of traders likely to continue supporting the market," said a major. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870 3082)
